verdict.rationale: The vendor ships an API reference page for creating a model response. It has code samples selectable per language (HTTP, Python, TypeScript, Go, Ruby, Java, curl) with example requests and responses, and is backed by a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 spec. That reference covers the general OpenAI platform API rather than a Codex-specific API, and nothing shows the examples can be run in-browser. Codex's own programmatic interface (the experimental, now-deprecated MCP server JSON-RPC API) is documented only as prose. missing for 10: a Codex-specific interactive API reference, evidence that examples execute in place (try-it console), coverage of the Codex app server API, independent or hands-on corroboration.
